title: South Irrigation Water — May 15
summary: The south irrigation leak was worked on most of t…
public_detail: The south irrigation leak was worked on most of today, but due to the complexity and location of the break they were unable to complete the repair before the end of the day. They will resume work on the repair on Monday morning and restore the irrigation water once completed. Due to this, the south irrigation water will remain off over the weekend. North irrigation water remains on. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
